title: Consulting Engineer (Data Center and ACI)
desc:
For one of our clients – a global leader in the telecommunications industry – we are looking for an experienced Network Consulting Engineer to join their team. This is an exciting opportunity to work on large-scale, customer-facing projects within a dynamic international environment, delivering innovative technology solutions.
Network Consulting Engineer based in Istanbul (hybrid work)
Key requirements:
• Fluent English and Turkish language (written and spoken)
• A university degree, preferably in Telecommunications or Computer Science
• Experience with Data Centre technologies and Cisco ACI
• Strong routing, switching and troubleshooting skills
• CCNP or CCIE-level knowledge
• Availability to start immediately
Thank you very much for your interest in this opportunity and for taking the time to submit your application.
Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we regret that we are only able to contact candidates whose qualifications and experience most closely match the requirements of the role.
Thank you for your understanding.
